Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the 405–406 date range and incorrectly resolved it as “end of 405,” despite multiple sources (e.g., Wikipedia) indicating the crossing occurred on December 31, 406. This improper tie-break and disregard for the “at the end of which year” phrasing led toward the wrong year (405) instead of the correct 406.
